The invention relates to a homogeneous, solid, particulate, urea ammonium sulphate-based composition comprising urea ammonium sulphate and a phosphoric triamide-type urease inhibitor. The composition is further characterized by one or more of the following features: (a) it comprises 5 weight % or less, relative to the total weight of the composition, of one or more alkaline or alkaline-forming inorganic or organic compounds capable of interacting with ammonium sulphate; (b) the phosphoric triamide-type urease inhibitor is present in solid particulate form; and/or (c) an anticaking and/or moisture-repellent coating is applied to the particulate urea ammonium sulphate material.

The invention concerns a uniform, solid, granular composition based on urea ammonium sulphate that contains urea ammonium sulphate and a phosphoric triamide-type urease inhibitor. The composition is additionally defined by at least one of the following features: (a) it contains no more than 5% by weight, based on the composition’s total weight, of one or more inorganic or organic alkaline or alkaline-generating substances capable of interacting with ammonium sulphate; (b) the phosphoric triamide-type urease inhibitor is present as solid particles; and/or (c) the urea ammonium sulphate particles are provided with an anticaking and/or moisture-resistant coating.

This composition offers enhanced reduction of ammonia losses resulting from urease activity in soil and is especially suitable for use as a fertilizer.

The invention also encompasses a process for producing a homogeneous, solid, particulate urea ammonium sulphate-based composition containing urea, ammonium sulphate, and a phosphoric triamide-type urease inhibitor, particularly N-(n-butyl) thiophosphoric triamide (nBTPT).

In addition, the invention covers a kit-of-parts composition comprising: (a) one or more alkaline or alkaline-forming inorganic substances capable of interacting with ammonium sulphate; (b) a phosphoric triamide-type urease inhibitor in either solid particulate or liquid form, preferably N-(n-butyl) thiophosphoric triamide (nBTPT); and, optionally, (c) one or more anticaking and/or moisture-repellent substances.
outputs.L3:
The invention relates to a homogeneous, solid, particulate composition based on urea ammonium sulphate and containing a phosphoric triamide urease inhibitor. The composition comprises no more than 5% by weight of alkaline or alkaline-forming compounds capable of interacting with ammonium sulphate, thereby maintaining the desired stability and performance of the product.

The phosphoric triamide urease inhibitor may be incorporated in solid particulate form. The resulting particles may additionally be provided with an anticaking and/or moisture-repellent coating to improve storage stability, handling, and resistance to agglomeration or moisture uptake.

When applied to soil, the composition inhibits urease activity and consequently reduces the loss of nitrogen through ammonia volatilization. It is therefore particularly suitable for use as a fertilizer that provides improved nitrogen-use efficiency.

The invention further encompasses a method for manufacturing the composition. It also covers a kit comprising an alkaline or alkaline-forming compound, a phosphoric triamide urease inhibitor—such as N-(n-butyl)thiophosphoric triamide (nBTPT)—and, optionally, one or more anticaking or moisture-repellent compounds.
outputs.L4:
The invention relates to a homogeneous, solid, particulate urea ammonium sulphate fertilizer composition that includes a phosphoric triamide urease inhibitor. In particular, the urease inhibitor may be N-(n-butyl)thiophosphoric triamide (nBTPT), although other suitable phosphoric triamides may also be used. By incorporating the inhibitor into or onto the fertilizer particles, the composition delays the urease-catalysed hydrolysis of urea after application to soil and thereby reduces the loss of nitrogen through ammonia volatilization.

The fertilizer is formulated to preserve the activity, stability, and distribution of the urease inhibitor within the particulate product. This may be achieved by using only limited quantities of alkaline additives, which can otherwise adversely affect the inhibitor or the physical properties of the fertilizer. The inhibitor may also be introduced in a solid form, facilitating uniform dosing and avoiding disadvantages associated with liquid inhibitor formulations. In certain embodiments, the fertilizer particles are provided with an anticaking or moisture-repellent coating. Such a coating can improve storage and handling, limit moisture uptake and particle agglomeration, and help protect the inhibitor during manufacture, transport, and storage.

The invention further encompasses methods for manufacturing the fertilizer. These methods may include combining urea and ammonium sulphate, incorporating a solid phosphoric triamide inhibitor during particle formation or applying it to previously formed particles, and optionally treating the particles with an anticaking or hydrophobic coating. Process conditions and additive levels are selected to produce a substantially homogeneous particulate material while minimizing degradation or deactivation of the inhibitor.

Also provided are kit-of-parts arrangements in which the urea ammonium sulphate fertilizer, the solid urease inhibitor, and, where appropriate, an alkaline additive or coating material are supplied separately for controlled combination before or during manufacture or use. These arrangements allow the components to be stored under suitable conditions and mixed in predetermined proportions.

When applied to soil, the resulting fertilizer provides both nitrogen and sulphur while more effectively suppressing urease activity and reducing ammonia emissions from urea hydrolysis. Improved retention of fertilizer nitrogen can increase nitrogen-use efficiency, enhance agronomic performance, and reduce the environmental impact associated with ammonia volatilization. The composition therefore offers improved stability, handling, storage, and field performance compared with comparable urea ammonium sulphate fertilizers lacking the protected or appropriately formulated urease inhibitor.
outputs.L5:
### The Power of “The”

“The” is one of the smallest yet most frequently used words in the English language. Known as the definite article, it identifies a specific person, place, object, or idea. For example, “a book” can mean any book, while “the book” refers to a particular one.

Despite its simplicity, “the” plays an important role in communication. It adds clarity, creates emphasis, and helps connect ideas. It can even change the meaning of a sentence: calling someone “a leader” is different from calling them “the leader.”

The word may seem ordinary, but it demonstrates how even the shortest elements of language can have a powerful effect.

counterfactuals.prompt: Draft a patent abstract for a homogeneous solid particulate urea ammonium sulphate fertilizer containing a phosphoric triamide urease inhibitor, including composition, manufacturing method, and kit-of-parts claims.
counterfactuals.output:
## Title

**Homogeneous Urea Ammonium Sulphate Fertilizer Containing a Phosphoric Triamide Urease Inhibitor**

## Abstract

A homogeneous solid particulate fertilizer comprises urea, ammonium sulphate, and at least one phosphoric triamide urease inhibitor distributed within the particles. The urea and ammonium sulphate may be present at a weight ratio of 50:50 to 95:5, and the urease inhibitor may constitute 0.001 to 0.2 wt.% of the fertilizer. The fertilizer is produced by combining urea, ammonium sulphate, and the urease inhibitor in a melt, slurry, solution, or granulation feed, forming particles by granulation, prilling, pelletizing, or compaction, and cooling and optionally drying the particles under conditions that retain urease-inhibiting activity. The internal distribution of the inhibitor reduces segregation and provides controlled application of nitrogen and sulphur with reduced ammonia volatilization. Also disclosed is a kit comprising a urea-ammonium sulphate fertilizer component and a separately packaged phosphoric triamide urease-inhibitor formulation, optionally with instructions for producing or applying the homogeneous particulate fertilizer.

## Exemplary Claims

1. **A homogeneous solid particulate fertilizer composition** comprising:  
   (a) urea;  
   (b) ammonium sulphate; and  
   (c) at least one phosphoric triamide urease inhibitor,  
   wherein the urea, ammonium sulphate, and phosphoric triamide urease inhibitor are distributed within individual particles of the fertilizer composition.

2. The fertilizer composition of claim 1, wherein the urea and ammonium sulphate are present at a weight ratio of from 50:50 to 95:5.

3. The fertilizer composition of claim 1 or claim 2, wherein the phosphoric triamide urease inhibitor is present in an amount of from 0.001 to 0.2 wt.% based on the total weight of the fertilizer composition.

4. The fertilizer composition of any preceding claim, wherein the phosphoric triamide urease inhibitor comprises a phosphoric triamide, a thiophosphoric triamide, or a mixture thereof.

5. The fertilizer composition of any preceding claim, wherein the urease inhibitor comprises N-(n-butyl)thiophosphoric triamide, N-(n-propyl)thiophosphoric triamide, or a combination thereof.

6. The fertilizer composition of any preceding claim, wherein the particles have an average particle size of from 0.5 mm to 6 mm.

7. The fertilizer composition of any preceding claim, wherein at least 80 wt.% of the particles contain urea, ammonium sulphate, and the urease inhibitor.

8. The fertilizer composition of any preceding claim, further comprising one or more of a carrier, stabilizer, anticaking agent, micronutrient, nitrification inhibitor, binder, colorant, or additional plant nutrient.

9. **A method of manufacturing a homogeneous solid particulate fertilizer**, the method comprising:  
   (a) providing urea and ammonium sulphate as a melt, slurry, solution, particulate feed, or combination thereof;  
   (b) introducing a phosphoric triamide urease inhibitor into the urea and ammonium sulphate;  
   (c) mixing the resulting material to distribute the urease inhibitor therein;  
   (d) forming the mixed material into solid particles; and  
   (e) cooling and optionally drying the solid particles to obtain particles comprising the urea, ammonium sulphate, and urease inhibitor.

10. The method of claim 9, wherein the particles are formed by granulation, prilling, pelletizing, extrusion, spray solidification, or compaction.

11. The method of claim 9 or claim 10, wherein the urease inhibitor is introduced as a solution, suspension, dispersion, encapsulated material, or carrier-supported formulation.

12. The method of any of claims 9–11, wherein the urease inhibitor is introduced at a temperature and residence time selected to retain at least 70% of its urease-inhibiting activity.

13. The method of any of claims 9–12, wherein the urease inhibitor is introduced during granulation or before solidification such that the inhibitor is incorporated within the resulting particles rather than being present solely as an external coating.

14. **A kit of parts for preparing or applying a stabilized urea ammonium sulphate fertilizer**, the kit comprising:  
   (a) a first package containing a solid urea-ammonium sulphate fertilizer component; and  
   (b) a second package containing a phosphoric triamide urease-inhibitor formulation,  
   wherein the first and second packages are provided together with instructions for combining or applying their contents at a rate effective to reduce urease-mediated ammonia volatilization.

15. The kit of claim 14, wherein the urease-inhibitor formulation comprises the phosphoric triamide urease inhibitor dissolved, dispersed, encapsulated, or supported in or on a liquid or solid carrier.

16. The kit of claim 14 or claim 15, wherein the instructions specify an inhibitor application rate providing from 0.001 to 0.2 wt.% phosphoric triamide urease inhibitor relative to the combined fertilizer composition.

counterfactuals.prompt: Write a technical description of a fertilizer composition designed to reduce ammonia loss caused by urease activity in soil. Specify that it contains no more than 5 wt% alkaline compounds, a particulate phosphoric triamide inhibitor, and/or a protective coating.
counterfactuals.output:
A stabilized fertilizer composition for reducing ammonia volatilization caused by soil urease activity comprises:

1. **A nitrogen-containing fertilizer substrate**, preferably particulate urea or a urea-containing fertilizer;
2. **No more than 5 wt% alkaline compounds**, based on the total weight of the composition, wherein alkaline compounds include basic carbonates, hydroxides, oxides, silicates, or other materials that increase local pH;
3. **A particulate phosphoric triamide urease inhibitor**, distributed within, admixed with, or deposited on the fertilizer particles; and/or
4. **A protective coating** applied to at least part of the fertilizer-particle surface.

The phosphoric triamide inhibitor suppresses urease-catalyzed hydrolysis of urea, thereby limiting rapid pH elevation and reducing conversion of fertilizer nitrogen to volatile ammonia. The inhibitor is provided in particulate form to facilitate controlled distribution and storage stability. The optional protective coating may comprise a polymeric, waxy, lipid-based, sulfur-containing, inorganic, or composite barrier and may encapsulate the inhibitor, the fertilizer substrate, or both. The coating protects the inhibitor from moisture, heat, premature degradation, and chemical interaction during storage and application, while permitting release after contact with soil moisture.

Maintaining the alkaline-compound content at or below 5 wt% reduces alkaline microenvironments that promote ammonia formation and can destabilize the inhibitor. The resulting composition provides improved nitrogen retention and fertilizer-use efficiency following soil application.

counterfactuals.prompt: Generate a European-style patent abstract for a homogeneous granular urea–ammonium sulphate composition containing N-(n-butyl) thiophosphoric triamide, and describe related production methods and a kit of parts.
counterfactuals.output:
**Abstract**

The invention relates to a homogeneous granular fertiliser composition comprising urea, ammonium sulphate and N-(n-butyl)thiophosphoric triamide (NBPT), wherein the ammonium sulphate and NBPT are distributed within the urea-containing granules. The composition provides nitrogen and sulphur nutrients together with urease inhibition, thereby reducing ammonia volatilisation following soil application. A method for producing the composition comprises combining ammonium sulphate with molten or dissolved urea, incorporating NBPT or an NBPT-containing formulation into the resulting mixture, and granulating, prilling or compacting the mixture, followed by cooling and, optionally, screening and surface treatment. Alternatively, NBPT is introduced during granule formation or absorbed into preformed porous urea–ammonium sulphate granules. Processing conditions are selected to limit degradation of NBPT and provide substantially uniform distribution thereof. The invention further relates to a kit of parts comprising a urea–ammonium sulphate component and a separately packaged NBPT-containing component, together with instructions for combining the components to form or treat homogeneous fertiliser granules.

The compositions are applied to soil, crops or growing media to suppress urease activity, reduce ammonia loss from urea and improve nitrogen-use efficiency and crop performance. They may be manufactured by forming or obtaining UAS particles—by granulation, prilling, compaction or blending—and incorporating, coating or otherwise applying the inhibitor before, during or after particle formation, with drying and low-moisture storage where appropriate. The disclosure also covers kits comprising the UAS fertilizer and the phosphoric triamide inhibitor as separate components, optionally together with a stabilizer, coating or carrier and instructions or equipment for mixing or applying them.
